$root = new class {};
echo $root::class, "|";
try {
    eval(<<<'BAD'
class Ghost151Review {}
$would = new class {};
echo 'never|';
function broken151Review(
BAD);
} catch (\ParseError $e) { echo "rejected|"; }
try {
    $ghost = new Ghost151Review;
    echo "published|";
} catch (\Error $e) { echo "absent|"; }
$after = new class {};
echo $after::class, "|";
eval('$tail = new class {}; echo $tail::class, "|";');

<?php
class Base151Review {
    public int $n;
    public function __construct($n) { echo "ctor|"; $this->n = $n; }
}
function reject151Review($code) {
    try { eval($code); } catch (\ParseError $e) { echo "reject|"; }
}
eval('$first = new class {}; echo $first::class, "|";');
reject151Review('$would = new class {}; if (');
reject151Review('class Never151Review {} function broken151Review(');
eval(<<<'CODE'
namespace Later151Review;
use Base151Review as B;
function argument151Review() {
    static $first = true;
    echo "arg|";
    if ($first) { $first = false; throw new \Exception("first"); }
    return 9;
}
function make151Review() {
    return new class(argument151Review()) extends B {};
}
try { make151Review(); } catch (\Exception $e) { echo "caught|"; }
$a = make151Review();
$b = make151Review();
echo $a::class, "|", $a->n, "|", ($a::class === $b::class), "|", ($a !== $b), "|";
CODE);
eval('$tail = new class {}; echo $tail::class, "|";');

<?php
$before = eval('return new class {};');
echo $before::class, '|';
try { eval('class GhostCompile151 {} $unused = new class {}; class Invalid151 { final abstract private function bad(); }'); }
catch (CompileError $error) { echo $error->getMessage(), '|'; }
try { $ghost = new GhostCompile151; echo 'published|'; }
catch (Error $error) { echo 'unpublished|'; }
$after = eval('return new class {};');
echo $after::class, '|', $before === $after ? 'same' : 'fresh';

<?php
class Root151Base {
 public int $number = 0;
 public function __construct(int $number) { $this->number = $number; echo 'ctor|'; }
}
try { $first = include_once __DIR__ . '/bad.php'; echo 'first-return|'; }
catch (ParseError $error) { echo 'first-parse|', $error->getFile(), ':', $error->getLine(), '|'; }
try { $second = include_once __DIR__ . '/bad.php'; echo 'second-return|'; }
catch (ParseError $error) { echo 'second-parse|', $error->getFile(), ':', $error->getLine(), '|'; }
$good = include __DIR__ . '/good.php';
$hit = include_once __DIR__ . '/good.php';
echo $good::class, '|', $good->number, '|', $hit ? 'once|' : 'miss|';
eval('echo (new class {})::class;');
